## Objective
- Finish the existing football card game with field animations, crowd cheers, and mobile-friendly controls.
- Validate gameplay and visuals in Chromium and save/inspect a fresh JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- Animate the token along yard lines and show a yellow first-down line.
- Animate dice rolls on big plays; play crowd cheers on touchdowns and turnovers.
- Keep buttons large for thumb-friendly mobile tapping.
- Continue the existing game rather than starting over.

## Decisions
- Use system Chromium with Node Playwright for browser validation.

## Work State
### Completed
- `card-game.js` has field dice markup/animation logic, synthesized crowd-cheer hooks, and triggers for touchdowns, turnovers, and gains of 15+ yards.
- `card-game.css` now includes the yellow first-down line, smooth ball movement, dice styling/animation, reduced-motion handling, and larger mobile touch targets.
- `node --check card-game.js` ran without a reported syntax error.

### Active
- Validate gameplay and visuals in Chromium, including touchdown/turnover effects and mobile button sizing.
